title: Publish the unified flywheel bundle results
description:
## Purpose

Publish a one-page result for the unified flywheel bundle experiment.

## Scope

A page in `studies/`: arm table (accuracy, Brier, ECE), paired intervals for F vs F-rand, A-c+F vs A-c and F, A-c+F vs A+D-v1 (0.918), A-c vs A; analyst questions and comment attribution; actual spend; L2 and single-seed caveats; and the §5.4 consequence for each comparison (e.g. F within ±1 point of F-rand → ship the plain list as default).

## Definition of done

Page committed and linked from the initiative; owner decision Q3 raised if A+D leads by ≥3 points. Cost: $0.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §5.1, §5.4.
